case_level_notes: Direct furnisher dispute with internal correction but missing CRA correction notice; direct-furnisher duty incomplete on CRA-correction prong.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Marking true under not-applicable branch per instructions; not asserting a CRA notice was actually sent.
determinations.decisive_branch: not-applicable branch (direct furnisher dispute only, no CRA path)

material_facts.fact: Customer submitted a direct dispute to the bank's published dispute address
No CRA receipt or CRA notice path is described

determinations.rationale: This is a direct furnisher dispute, not a CRA-transmitted dispute. The CRA furnisher-notice transmission branch is outside the case's natural scope.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Per instructions, downstream third-party notification failures are not item-treatment failures unless the determination requires that downstream act.

material_facts.fact: Bank agreed the balance was inaccurate
Bank modified the account record internally

determinations.rationale: Bank found the balance inaccurate and modified the account record internally, recording the corrected status. Item treatment under section 5 concerns the item's verified/deleted/modified status, not downstream CRA notification.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Treating inapplicable branch as satisfied per instructions; not asserting indirect investigation occurred.

material_facts.fact: Direct dispute only; no ACDV or CRA notice to the bank

determinations.rationale: No CRA-transmitted indirect dispute occurred; the furnisher indirect duty branch is outside the case's natural scope.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: The direct-furnisher determination per perspective evidence duties expressly includes 'Correct, delete, block, or report corrections,' so failure to notify CRAs of the correction makes this duty incomplete.
determinations.decisive_branch: direct-dispute defect-found branch — failed CRA correction reporting

material_facts.fact: Direct dispute received at published address with payoff confirmation
Bank found balance inaccurate and modified internally
Bank file does not show corrected information was sent to the CRAs

determinations.rationale: Bank investigated the direct dispute, found inaccuracy, modified the record, and reported results to the consumer, but per section 10/11 duties incorporated for furnishers, the bank failed to report the corrected information to the CRAs that had received the inaccurate balance.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Routing is independent of substantive determinations; flagging review does not import a failure into item treatment.
determinations.decisive_branch: routing trigger — manual review for correction-forwarding failure

material_facts.fact: Corrected information was not sent to CRAs after inaccuracy found

determinations.rationale: A material discrepancy between the bank's internal correction and unsent CRA correction reporting is a routing trigger; downstream correction gap warrants manual review.
